 Filing: the US DOJ is seeking forfeiture of $1B+ in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance by hackers linked to North Korea   —  The US is seeking forfeiture of more than $1 billion in cryptocurrency that was stolen by hackers linked to North Korea from Binance Holdings Ltd., according to a court filing on Monday.
